"""Print the W2-122 README's map as gov accept reads it (parse_map), one line per KPI line."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from gov.accept.runner import ordered, parse_map

readme = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
mapping = parse_map(readme)
for name in ordered(mapping):
    print(name, len(mapping[name]), ", ".join(mapping[name]))
